scientific_question: Does the source-complete QKV norm+RoPE to E5M2 NHD KV-cache epilogue reduce median component time at every exact local/global geometry while preserving QKV and cache bytes?

reservation_gate.instruction: The requested reservation is not authority. Do not claim or touch the bench until a later director sees the exact project reservation in the durable spend snapshot and issues an execution binding.

execution_scope_after_future_binding.repetitions: as hash-bound by the offline consumer

quality_gates: Reject before CUDA on any source, model, accelerator, or runtime identity mismatch.
Require candidate QKV normalized RMSE no greater than 1e-5.
Require byte-exact K and V E5M2 cache outputs versus the unfused consumer.
Require every local and global geometry to pass.
Require registers per thread no greater than 32 and zero spills.
Require positive median component reduction at every exact geometry.

terminal_contract.positive: All correctness, resource, and per-geometry timing gates pass; persist the exact component ledger and release. Endpoint promotion remains a later director decision.
terminal_contract.negative: Any gate fails or any exact geometry has non-positive median reduction; persist the typed terminal and release without endpoint work.

prohibitions: Do not claim the bench before durable reservation and a later director execution binding.
Do not replay DFlash, NGRAM, gated-activation, or any consumed endpoint.
